name: What types of kitchen lighting are available for an upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What types of kitchen lighting are available for an upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen lighting upgrades typically involve a combination of task, ambient, and accent lighting. Task lighting focuses on specific work areas, such as under-cabinet lights for countertops or pendant lights over an island. Ambient lighting provides general illumination for the entire kitchen, often through recessed lighting or flush-mount fixtures. Accent lighting highlights features like artwork or decorative elements. LED technology is now standard for most types, offering energy efficiency and a long lifespan. Understanding these types helps create a functional and aesthetically pleasing kitchen lighting scheme.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen lighting includes task, ambient, and accent lighting, often using energy-efficient LED technology.
